digest.component_or_area: reconciler rich-text cutover and baseline state management
propositions: Cloud send paths must point AdfCodec operations at Markdown-aware functions and emit structured ADF exactly once per body, converging on subsequent passes without re-emit.
DC send and create paths must compose to_wire(fit_outbound(...)) to render Markdown as wiki text on both update and create, preventing raw Markdown from reaching the issue.

Local baseline comparisons must normalize the local side through normalize_outbound (decode∘to_wire) while emit comparisons normalize only the remote side via decode_inbound, ensuring lossy round-trip cancellation and suppressing spurious changes.

An 8-byte change-gated rich_sha stored inline in binding entries bounds reemit loops to one GET at threshold RICH_REEMIT_OBSERVE_AT=2, with counter reset only on actual wire change, adding zero entries on no-op passes.
Concurrent both-sides edits on description must raise outbound-field-conflict alerts and record remote values while preserving rebar-local changes, unchanged from story a713.
With cutover flag OFF or marklas extra absent, the plain-text ADF wire path remains unchanged and byte-identical, with no new imports or side effects in the core apply layer.
